title: zum kreischenden Klaus 2026
description: A multiplayer-focused Cobblemon modpack with a server-first economy, gym battles that award BadgeBox badges, and badge-based progression unlocks.
body:
## About
Welcome to **zkk_cobblemon** — a carefully curated Cobblemon experience built for our community server and Twitch tavern: **“Zum kreischenden Klaus”**.

This pack is designed for long-term multiplayer progression: build towns, explore a rich world, challenge Radical Trainers & Gyms, collect badges, and develop an economy that feels earned.

We are a german community, you can find the community here:
- Twitch: https://twitch.tv/dietaverne

## Core gameplay
- **Cobblemon-focused progression**: catching, training, and team-building are the heart of the pack.
- **Gyms & badges**: gym victories grant physical **BadgeBox** badges, and rematches let you re-earn a badge if you ever lose it.
- **Badge-based unlocks**: badges can be used to permanently unlock access to badge-gated shops per player (admin Build shops on server).
- **Economy-first multiplayer**: the pack is balanced around **Lightman’s Currency**.

## Multiplayer/server-friendly
- **Claim protection** via Open Parties and Claims with hardened interaction rules.
- **Quality-of-life defaults** (keybinds and sensible settings) shipped in a way that stays update-safe.

## Notes
- This modpack is intended for community play on the zkk server; singleplayer works, but the economy/claims/badge flow shines most on a server.
